A1.justification: Both contain the same complete 36-page SQDF paper, including Appendices A–H. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical manuscript content; only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its self-link differ.

before.justification: v1 reports original text-to-image fine-tuning and online black-box optimization experiments in Section 5, component ablations, and SDXL results in Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, ablations, and appendix results unchanged.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix H retain the same SQDF objective and update procedure, including discounting, consistency-model estimation, and replay-buffer sampling.

E1.justification: Both retain the Gaussian-mixture toy task, animal prompts, HPDv2 prompts, text-to-image reward optimization, and online black-box optimization described in Section 5 and Appendix D.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical: DDPO, DRaFT, ReFL and the reported KL variants in text-to-image experiments; PPO+KL and SEIKO variants in black-box optimization; pretrained SDXL and DRaFT in Appendix F.

E3.justification: Sections 5 and Appendices D/F retain identical model configurations, training budgets, prompt splits, metrics, and testing procedures, including 32 evaluation images per prompt and 15,360 total oracle queries.

E4.justification: The discount-factor, consistency-model, and buffer ablations, DDIM comparison, prioritization and sensitivity studies, and qualitative collapse/diversity analyses are identical in Section 5.3 and the appendices.

E5.justification: Both retain the three-random-seed disclosures in Section 5 and Appendix F and the mean/standard-deviation reporting in Table 1. No uncertainty reporting or statistical procedure changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4, plotted results, and qualitative examples are identical. For example, Table 1 retains SQDF-UCB's aesthetic score of 7.87 with standard deviation 0.15, and Table 3 retains SQDF's SDXL aesthetic score of 7.86.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, objectives, gradients, and derivations are unchanged, including the soft Bellman equations and discounted soft-Q bounds and approximation in Appendices A–B.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about training-free soft-Q estimation, reward optimization with preserved diversity, and sample-efficient black-box optimization.

C2.justification: Explanations of approximation error, credit assignment, training stability, and reward-diversity trade-offs remain identical in Sections 4.2/5.3 and Appendix E. No substantive qualification or limitation changes.

D1.justification: Appendices D and H retain identical implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, timings, prompt processing, and pseudocode. The code-access statement and its hyperlink destination are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical, with no added or removed cited works or revised positioning relative to prior research.

P1.justification: Only the administrative arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 4 December 2025 to v2 dated 13 January 2026. Manuscript wording, headings, and organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–21, Tables 1–4, algorithm displays, captions, and their placement are identical. The stamp text update does not alter the manuscript layout.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and presentation throughout the main text and appendices. Updating the administrative version/date stamp and self-link produces no meaningful change in overall paper quality.
